recap.text: Uzzi, a skyfowl Storm Commander, uses a party protection spell to keep caustic rain off his party at a stairwell. To open the puzzle, Chaco throws the Dart of Ophiotaurus into Uzzi's breast, locking him in a containment that tears his chest open. Odette tells Carl that Uzzi died because of a broken deal involving Huanxin and Armita. Mordecai survived and drinks himself into oblivion.

beats.headline: Guarding the last stairwell
beats.text: For the record, from a season long gone: tenth floor, collapse imminent, three crawlers at a stairwell, and a fourth still on his way back to it, that opens only when a storm god's magic touches a primed puzzle. Uzzi, skyfowl, Storm Commander, the class Mordecai once said his brother took on Odette's advice. He guards the others while Hold Steady keeps the puzzle primed and Chaco plays to draw the gods. His magic is limited. His party protection spell is what keeps the caustic rain off everyone. Odette notes that he chose the hardest of four paths, blindly.
beats.gist: Uzzi, a skyfowl Storm Commander, guards three crawlers at a stairwell during a tenth floor collapse.

beats.headline: See you on the other side
beats.text: The storm goddess is sponsored, and her sponsor has turned on them. Mordecai tells the group chat he has a plan and it will kill him; to Odette alone he explains it: his Final Blow skill can target the puzzle, so if the god hits him, the puzzle is hit too. "Uzzi, see you on the other side, brother." Uzzi's reply, in full: "Do not even dare." The brothers go back and forth while the timer falls. Odette knows that if Uzzi were told the other plan, he would be on board. There is no time to tell him.
beats.gist: Mordecai tells Odette his Final Blow skill can hit the puzzle if a god hits him.

beats.headline: The dart in his breast
beats.text: Chaco worships the goddess and tells Uzzi he is sorry. Uzzi turns to him, looks down at the Dart of Ophiotaurus in the bard's hand, lifts his head to the rain, and caws a war cry. He steps nearer the puzzle and spreads his wings. He understood. Chaco throws the dart into his breast and locks him in a containment with the puzzle. Mordecai arrives in ratkin form, falls to his knees at the shell, and calls his brother's name. The summoning tears Uzzi's chest open. Crawler Uzzi has fallen.
beats.gist: Chaco throws the Dart of Ophiotaurus into Uzzi's breast and locks him in a containment.

beats.headline: Odette tells her side of it
beats.text: Odette tells Carl the story in her own words, fast, with Lexis warning her the time is short: an illegal deal with Huanxin, brokered by Armita; a price raised; a deal broken at the last second; a goddess trapped in a containment, then killed by Chaco. Mordecai made the next floor, she says. Uzzi, Mordecai's brother, died. Since then she has watched him every chance she could, drinking himself into oblivion, crying over his brother. Her own verdict: this one I broke.
beats.gist: Odette tells Carl about a broken deal with Huanxin and a goddess killed by Chaco.
